items.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Jack DeJohnette with me this morning

ctx.x: Jack was interviewed via Zoom on April 7, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Jack DeJohnette with me this morning, from your home. You’re near Woodstock, is that correct?
